intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 System State Baseline
detected_fault: High-pitch fan noise at low to medium speed, accompanied by thermal throttling issues.
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Ensure that all drivers are up-to-date, including graphics card drivers.
Consider deleting the CPU shader cache to resolve thermal throttling issues.
If the high-pitch fan noise persists, consider contacting ASUS support or a authorized service provider for further assistance.
